🔥 vulcan-launcher | Kotlin
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide Android users with a highly customizable and feature-rich home screen experience that prioritizes privacy and offline functionality.
✨ Key Features: • No internet access (completely offline) • No ads, trackers, or analytics • Nova Launcher-like features (icon packs, gestures, customization) • App drawer with search and organization • Customizable look and feel (icon shapes, themes)
📖 Summary: Vulcan is an Android home screen launcher designed with privacy and simplicity at its core. It offers a feature-rich experience similar to Nova Launcher but without any internet access, ads, trackers, or analytics, ensuring all data remains on the user's device.
